description: Retrieves carry-on baggage policy information from Aeromexico's website (www.aeromexico.com), supporting both English and Spanish pages with robust SPA content extraction.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_carry_on_english: Fetch carry-on baggage info in English; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_carry_on_spanish: Fetch carry-on baggage info in Spanish (equipaje de mano); 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_by_url: Fetch baggage info from a specific Aeromexico URL; 参数: url, locale; 必填: url
  - check_status: Check if the Aeromexico website is accessible; 参数: 无; 必填: 无

url.description:
Target URL for get_by_url function. Must be from aeromexico.com domain.
Example: https://www.aeromexico.com/en-us/travel-information/baggage/checked-baggage

locale.description:
Locale for content extraction (used with get_by_url function).
Examples: en-US, es-US, es-MX. Defaults to en-US.
